checkpoint_selection: minimum common unweighted validation focal loss among eligible epochs; earlier epoch breaks exact ties
candidate_interpretation: one-factor staged-finetuning validation-only experiment; not test/external confirmation

decision_logic.CLEAR_VALIDATION_IMPROVEMENT: Eligible Stage24 is no worse than the selected Stage23 candidate on every registered aggregate and classwise metric, improves at least one registered metric, and MEL recall and MEL F1 are each at least their Stage23 values.
decision_logic.MIXED_VALIDATION_RESULT: Eligible Stage24 improves at least one of accuracy, macro F1, MEL recall, or MEL F1 over Stage23, but has any registered regression; any loss of Stage23 MEL recall or MEL F1 prevents a clear-improvement interpretation.
decision_logic.NO_MEANINGFUL_IMPROVEMENT: Eligible Stage24 does not strictly improve any of accuracy, macro F1, MEL recall, or MEL F1 over Stage23.
decision_logic.NO_CANDIDATE_SELECTED: No Stage24 epoch satisfies all unchanged Stage23 eligibility gates.
decision_logic.EXPERIMENT_INVALID: Any provenance, frozen-config, data-boundary, numerical, checkpoint, sidecar, or artifact-integrity requirement fails.
